source.title: Coarse Weightstone
source.objective:
ProgressIt takes a lot of work to be the strongest woman alive!  My weight set is getting too light and if I'm too stay fit then I'll need more weights!

Do you think you could bring me some weight stones?  If you do, then I'll give you a Darkmoon Faire ticket.
source.completion:
Great!  These will work great!  They're not too heavy, but not too light either.  They're perfect for building muscle mass!

Thanks much, <name>.  Here's your Darkmoon Faire ticket!
